target_topology.okf_policy: Prefer docs/ as sole maintained knowledge bundle; top-level knowledge/ may remain only as a generated projection when a verified provider/tool requirement exists.

ordering_constraints: DPTN-B must clear occupied history paths before DPTN-C promotes canonical concepts/reference.
DPTN-C must stabilize current semantic paths before DPTN-D relocates the CKR ownership ledger and before DPTN-F rebinds agents.
DPTN-D must explicitly split mixed ADF/CKR directories; recursive bulk moves of either directory are forbidden.
DPTN-E must not create a second manually maintained knowledge hierarchy.
DPTN-F occurs after physical topology stabilizes so agents are rebound once, not through intermediate paths.
DPTN-G may retire aliases only after semantic/provenance/route conservation passes.
